headline: MIA @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 5.31 at PIT 3.87, with a projected total of 9.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +1.19 runs while PIT moved -0.42, changing the projected margin by +1.61 runs. The projected total climbed +0.76, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Lake Bachar has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Nick Gonzales, Spencer Horwitz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Esmerlyn Valdez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
